$comment: Every dependency and devDependency of every package.json (root, packages/*, tools/lint), with why Slate needs it. tools/guards/dependencies.test.ts fails on one that is missing here. Adding an entry is how a new dependency is proposed: the maintainer approves it in review (tools/guards/ is a security-sensitive path). Workspace packages (@slate/*) need no entry.
@azure/msal-node: Microsoft sign-in for the OneNote import and OneDrive sync (Graph tokens).
@eslint-community/eslint-plugin-eslint-c: Lint: a disable comment needs a reason and cannot switch off a guard rule.
@eslint/js: Lint: ESLint's core rule set, used by the flat config.
@fontsource-variable/inter: The UI font, bundled so the app needs no network font.
@fontsource-variable/source-serif-4: The serif note font, bundled so the app needs no network font.
@modelcontextprotocol/sdk: The MCP server agents use to read and write notes (slate-mcp).
@playwright/test: E2E tests that drive the real Electron app.
@tiptap/core: The rich-text editor inside each box.
@tiptap/extension-text-style: Editor: text colour and style marks.
@tiptap/pm: Editor: ProseMirror, which TipTap is built on.
@tiptap/starter-kit: Editor: the basic nodes and marks.
@types/node: Types for main-process, test and tool code.
@vitejs/plugin-react: Build: React support for the renderer bundle.
ajv: Validates docs/compliance/oscal against NIST's OSCAL 1.2.3 component schema (scripts/validate-oscal.mjs, compliance workflow, audit C10).
ajv-formats: Format keywords (uuid, date-time, uri) the OSCAL schema uses; loaded with ajv in scripts/validate-oscal.mjs (audit C10).
cross-env: Runs main-process tests under Electron's Node on every OS.
dependency-cruiser: Lint: package and process boundaries on the module graph.
electron-builder: Packages the installers (dmg, zip, deb, AppImage).
electron-updater: Downloads and verifies app updates from the GitHub release feed.
electron-vite: Build: bundles main, preload and renderer.
eslint: Lint: the linter that runs the slate/* guard rules.
fast-check: devDependency only (audit C11, §6.4): property-based fuzzing of every parser that sees untrusted bytes (T-FUZZ in vault/fuzz.test.ts), with shrinking counterexamples; never in app code.
globals: Lint: the global names of Node and the browser.
happy-dom: A DOM for the editor's unit tests.
hash-wasm: devDependency only since C4: the independent Argon2id reference for T-KAT-02 (kdf.test.ts) and T-ZERO-04; the app derives in @slate/native, and slate/crypto-through-native refuses it in source.
linkedom: Parses OneNote's HTML during import, outside a browser.
loro-crdt: The CRDT behind every page and notebook (sync and undo).
loro-prosemirror: Binds Loro documents to the ProseMirror editor.
node-addon-api: Build: the C++ headers of the better-sqlite3 binding vendored into @slate/native (header-only; nothing of it ships as JavaScript).
typescript: The compiler: TypeScript 7 for `tsc` at the root; TypeScript 6 in tools/lint for typescript-eslint, which needs its JavaScript API.
typescript-eslint: Lint: TypeScript parsing and type-aware rules.
vite: Build: the bundler under electron-vite and vitest.
vite-plugin-wasm: Build: loads Loro's WebAssembly in the renderer.
